title: GDPR Article 22 — Right not to be subject to a solely automated decision
description: The automated-decision-making safeguard within the GDPR. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary EUR-Lex text — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: Individuals have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing (including profiling) that produces legal effects concerning them or similarly significantly affects them, subject to narrow exceptions (contract necessity, law, or explicit consent) that still require safeguards including the right to obtain human intervention and to contest the decision.
